Flavorful Cơm Tấm with Fast Service
Jun 2026 • Solo
I ordered the cơm tấm sườn bì ốp la, and it was delicious. Althought the pork chop was not 100% tender, it was well-marinated with great flavor throughout. The shredded pork skin was light, flavorful, and complemented the dish. The fried egg had a jammy yolk and crispy edges. The broken rice was freshly cooked and not dry at all, while the fish sauce was well-balanced. My only minor complaint is that I wish there had been a bit more rice, though the generous portion of meat made the meal satisfying overall. The restaurant itself was airy, which made for a pleasant dining experience. Service was also fast. In fact, I received my order in less than a minute after placing it.

Some of the best food I had in Vietnam
May 2026 • Solo
This was one of my favorite places I at in Vietnam. It's a bit out of the way of downtown and the tourist sites (it took about 15-20 minutes to get there via motorbike taxi). It's in a cool neighborhood -- the place is busy, with lots of delivery drivers waiting outside, and I appeared to be the only non-local there.

It's sort of an indoor-outdoor set up and very casual. The broken rice dish was excellent. It was nothing fancy but the flavor on the pork was outstanding. I would highly recommend it.

Return visit in Sept. 2025. Not great.
Sep 2025 • Couples
Came back to Saigon in Sept. 2025. I left a TripAdvisor review of this place back in 2022 before this place got Michelin recognition. 

I had this place on my food itinerary. Came here during the afternoon to experience a great lunch. Ordered the grilled pork chop with shredded pork and fried egg. Shredded pork and eggs were typical quality with other broken rice/Com Tam places. 

The star of the dish is of course the grilled pork chop. This time I was disappointed. It was plain Jane. It was missing the sweetness from the Maillard reaction that brought hungry patrons in the first place. The pork chop was also a the dry side. Definitely not juicy like when I first went there. Quality was a miss. Not worth the Michelin recognition and definitely not worth the price anymore at this time. Hope next time would be better.

A Must-Visit for Cơm Tấm Lovers! - Michelin Selected in HCMC
Mar 2025 • Couples
If you’re a fan of Vietnamese broken rice, Cơm Tấm Ba Ghiền is a must-visit! This place truly lives up to its reputation, and it’s no surprise that it’s Michelin-selected.

The highlight of the meal was the grilled pork chop (sườn)—massive (about 400-500g before grilling), juicy, tender, and packed with flavor. The portion was so generous that I struggled to finish it! 
*Note: a bigger size of the grilled pork chop is available upon request.

My husband and I ordered the combination plate “thập cẩm” and the grilled pork chop, shredded pork & skin pork, steamed egg cake “sườn bì chả” plate, along with a bowl of soup. Every bite was delicious and satisfying. Our meal cost 306,000 VND, which was well worth it for the quality and portion sizes.

Service was super fast and efficient, even though the place was packed by 6 PM. Be prepared for a crowd, as they don’t take reservations. If you’re riding a motorcycle, there’s free parking, but note that car parking is not available before 6 PM.

Overall, an amazing local food experience with authentic flavors and great value. Highly recommend!
